nodes.label: Twelve-Candidate Pairwise Elo Run
nodes.rationale: Across 816 pairwise judgments, Qwen3 235B ranked first at 1898.94, followed by Claude Haiku 4.5 at 1768.43 and Gemma 3 27B at 1704.97; most candidates had 149 matches, while Kimi K2.5 had only 11.

nodes.label: Pairwise Dialogue Judge Criteria
nodes.rationale: The pairwise judge repeatedly distinguishes candidates using period authenticity, idiomatic Hiberno-English, direct responsiveness, character voice, vivid detail, and absence of anachronisms.
